Component Library

26 accessible, themeable components built on the HISD "Connected Futures" design system. Every component paints color only through semantic tokens, ships a visible focus ring, and works in light and dark. Open any demo to see all states in both themes with a copy-paste snippet.

Forms & inputs

button Four intent variants — action, secondary, ghost, danger — with loading state. input-text Text field with label-above, helper text, and an error state wired via aria-describedby. textarea Multi-line input sharing the field shell; vertical resize only. select Native select with a tokenized custom chevron and the shared focus/error shell. selection-controls Custom-styled checkbox and radio (grouped in a fieldset). switch role=switch toggle with a perceivable OFF-state boundary. theme-toggle Icon-only light/dark control with aria-pressed state.

Navigation

navbar Top navigation with a skip-link, current-page accent, and a mobile drawer. sidebar Sidebar navigation with grouped sections and an inline-start active rail. tabs APG tabs — roving focus, arrow-key activation, overflow scroll. breadcrumb Breadcrumb trail with aria-current on the leaf and presentational separators. pagination Page navigation with prev/next bounds, ellipsis, and aria-current.

Feedback & status

alert Inline banner in four semantic variants — meaning carried by icon + text, not color. toast Live-region toasts that stack, auto-dismiss, and use the status token set. tooltip Hover/focus label wired via aria-describedby; never the sole label. progress Determinate bar (role=progressbar) and a reduced-motion-safe indeterminate variant. skeleton Loading placeholders with a paused-under-reduce sheen, the opacity crossfade, and a CLS-proof media frame. badge Count and status markers; labelled when they carry information alone.

Content & containers

card Surface container; raised with shadow in light, strengthened border in dark. chip Filter/selection tag; selected state carries ink on the yellow fill. table Data table with zebra rows, sortable headers (aria-sort), and a scroll region. accordion Disclosure pattern with aria-expanded headers and labelled panels. avatar Image or initials fallback, sizes, and an optional accessible status dot. modal Blocking dialog with focus trap; destructive variant uses role=alertdialog. map Accessible map shell — DOM list is source of truth; renderer (MapLibre/ArcGIS) plugs into the canvas. ribbon Animated bayou ribbon graphic device — a gradient band with a compositor-only drift, guarded under reduced-motion and forced-colors.
